## Mathematics 1 -- FON

### Tutorials

Below are the practice materials for Mathematics 1, translated into English, created during the 2025/26 academic year in collaboration with my colleague Dunja Prokić from the Department of Mathematics at the Faculty of Organizational Sciences (FON). Clicking on a title opens the link leading to the corresponding PDF document. Many thanks to Maksim Bojović for assisting with the translation.

## Teaching experience

I have taught exercise sessions at the following institutions:

- **University of Belgrade, Faculty of Organizational Sciences:** Mathematics 1, Mathematics 2;
- **University of Belgrade, Faculty of Mathematics:** Statistical Software 3, Information Theory, Introduction to Sampling Theory, Probability and Statistics B, Introduction to Financial Mathematics;
- **Mathematical Grammar School, Belgrade:** Analysis with Algebra (4th grade).
